db_evidence.notes: The automatic captioning pipeline (episodes/topic_facts/object_states/semantic_triples) explicitly names 不白 (~33300s) and 不空 (~39240-39270s, defeat via '已击败' + boss name in object_states/semantic_triples), and 不能 is reliably locatable via clip_qa visual reads at ~38190-38350 (on-screen '头目·不能' / '朱厌·不能', defeat ~38329-38331s, confirmed independently by rollouts 0 and 4). 不净's name never appears in any DB table (verified with sql LIKE '%净%' across episodes/event_steps/topic_facts/object_states/semantic_triples -- zero rows), so its position is unretrievable from text and must be established purely by visual inspection of the video. No rollout's clip_qa call produced a clean, legible on-screen '不净' name+defeat text; the closest candidate windows (37560-37830, 34590-34720, 39980-40230, 61560-61630) either returned other named bosses (赤尻马猫, 多臂巨..., 无量蝨, 妖王·晦月魔君) or a hallucinated/unconfirmed '不净' label.

root_causes: The upstream captioning/memory-build pipeline never captured the on-screen boss name '不净' in any structured table, so text-based retrieval (run_sql, semantic_search) can never locate it directly for any rollout

Multiple distinct boss fights are packed into the same nominal 3-minute episode window (e.g. 赤尻马猫 immediately followed by 不能 within 33240-38340), so a clip_qa call spanning too wide a window risks sampling the wrong fight, as happened in rollout-03

The clip_qa visual sub-agent sometimes produces a confident boss-identity claim without an actually legible name string in the sampled frames (rollout-04's '不净' at 40217s), which the retrieval agent then trusts without further verification

Because 不净 is unretrievable with confidence, every rollout effectively guesses its position among the other three confirmed bosses (不白 first, 不能 mid, 不空 last); only rollout-1's guess (slotting 不净 between the confirmed 不能 and 不空) happened to match the reference order
what_worked: All 5 rollouts correctly used semantic_search + run_sql to establish 不白 first (~33300s) and 不空 last (~39240-39270s) from directly-worded DB text, matching the reference's endpoints
Rollouts 0, 1(implicitly), 3, 4 used clip_qa with a targeted question ('is the on-screen name X?') to visually confirm 不能 at ~38329-38331s, which is the correct 2nd position

Rollout 0 correctly used clip_qa to rule OUT several plausible-looking candidate windows for 不净 (37560-37830, 31580-31860, 61560-61630) rather than accepting a false positive, even though it still guessed wrong overall
transferable_lessons: When one of several named entities in an ordering question has zero hits anywhere in the structured DB (verify with a broad LIKE search across all text-bearing tables), treat its exact position as unverified rather than guessing a specific slot; state the uncertainty in the answer instead of asserting a confident but unconfirmed order

When sending a clip_qa window that could contain more than one boss fight, narrow it to the specific sub-interval implied by nearby event_steps timestamps rather than the whole 2-3 minute episode span, to avoid sampling an adjacent unrelated fight

Do not accept a clip_qa answer that claims to identify a name/label when the sub-agent's own evidence description admits the text was not legible in the sampled frames -- re-sample denser frames or a different timestamp instead of trusting the claim

For 'order the following N entities' questions, once N-1 entities are anchored with high confidence, use the remaining entity's most plausible slot (between the two nearest confirmed anchors) rather than placing it at either extreme, since narrative/chronological adjacency is a weak but real prior when no direct evidence exists
open_questions: What is the true on-screen defeat time and name-card frame for 不净? None of the 5 rollouts' clip_qa calls produced a clean, legible confirmation, so the ground truth interval for 不净 remains unverified even after this diagnosis; a targeted frame-by-frame scan of 38340-39240 (between confirmed 不能 and 不空) was not performed here and could resolve this

Why does the automatic captioning pipeline capture 不白 and 不空's names but never 不净's, despite all four appearing in the same boss-rush sequence -- is this a caption-model failure specific to that boss's on-screen UI rendering (e.g. text color/contrast, camera angle) or a sampling gap in the 30-second caption cadence?
